scope: Re-baseline llama.cpp at latest master (HIP+Vulkan) on zbook for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-Q4_K_XL, fork/perf-setup survey, and pp508 per-kernel-family comparison vs hipEngine final production profile

qwen4exp_merge: 6fe749801 model: qwen4exp: reduce number of graph splits (#27880)
llama_cpp.builds: ~/llama.cpp/llama.cpp-hip build-hip and ~/llama.cpp/llama.cpp-vulkan build; out-of-tree Release; HIP flags AMDGPU_TARGETS=gfx1151 GGML_HIP_GRAPHS=ON GGML_HIP_MMQ_MFMA=ON GGML_HIP_NO_VMM=ON

pp508_kernel_family_comparison_ms.protocol: rocprofv3 kernel-trace, llama master warm segment (5121 launches, 1.693 s kernels) vs hipEngine final production trace (3684 launches, 6.548 s kernels); profiler overhead present in both

root_cause_analysis.moe_matmul: llama mul_mat_q takes AMD_WMMA_AVAILABLE path on gfx1151 (RDNA4 WMMA matrix cores, f16 fragments, f32 accumulate) per ggml-cuda/mma.cuh and mmq.cuh use_mma_data_layout(); hipEngine MMQ kernels are integer dp4a ('d4') variants. Effective expert-MMQ throughput at pp508: llama ~4.5 TFLOP/s vs hipEngine ~1.1 TFLOP/s; weight-stream floor ~260 ms (66 GB at ~256 GB/s), so both remain compute-dominated.
root_cause_analysis.gdn: llama fused gated_delta_net_cuda<128,...> processes 512-token chunks at ~2.39 ms/launch x36; hipEngine exact fused prefill kernel averages 26.8 ms x27 plus peer-wave32 chain x9. Algorithmic gap: chunked parallel scan with per-chunk state passing.
root_cause_analysis.qsa: llama flash_attn_tile<256,256,8,4> 1.21 ms x12 vs hipEngine paged full-attn prefill family 141.5 ms.

fork_survey.ik_llama_cpp: added qwen4exp runtime (#2365) + CUDA-only f32 small-GEMM fast TG (#2373); no gfx1151-specific advantage found
fork_survey.namore_rocmfp4_fork: rocmfp4-qwen3.8-flash-next-template branch + kingjones777 ROCmFP4 STRIX_LEAN GGUF (~100 GiB Q4_0-ROCmFP4), Vulkan backend; different quant, not comparable to UD-Q4_K_XL
fork_survey.community_fast_decode_claims: 50-65 tok/s decode reports use ROCmFP4 quant + DFlash2/native-MTP speculative forks (hogeheer499-commits/strix-halo-guide route matrix); adaptive 65 t/s route unverified/unpublished sidecar; not same-quant no-spec comparisons

fork_survey.hip_fix_pr_25863: not merged as of 17252c769; no ggml-hip commits since 2026-08-25 in master
fork_survey.vulkan_decode_master_gain: 77f132cb1 mul_mat_id pad K rather than N (#27925), 90c26fcd4 row-IDs hoisting (#26686), and qwen4exp merge account for Vulkan tg32 18.7->24.1

decision: Optimization priorities for parity: (1) WMMA f16 matrix-core MoE MMQ path (potential ~3-4 s at pp508), (2) port llama chunked gated_delta_net scan (~0.66 s), (3) flash-attn QSA prefill (~0.13 s). Decode gap smaller (1.10-1.55x); revisit after prefill modules land.
